business_problem: Founded in 2004, Clearwater aggregates, reconciles, and reports on more than 6.4 trillion dollars in assets with its software-as-a-service investment accounting solution.
solution_summary: When Clearwater Analytics (Clearwater)—a leading provider of software-as-a-service-based investment accounting, reporting, and analytics solutions—migrated to Amazon Web Services (AWS) to support rapid growth, establishing clear and consistent governance policies was paramount. On AWS, the business sought to scale globally and improve the reliability of its infrastructure with policies that would support developer productivity in a secure cloud environment by using AWS Cloud Governance services, a group of services that companies use to establish cloud governance across their AWS estate. Clearwater simplified multi-account governance using AWS Organizations , which companies use to create and manage new AWS accounts at no additional charge.

solution_components.name: AWS Lambda
solution_components.role: Executes serverless processing and workflow glue for the internal operations and automation workflows.

solution_components.name: AWS Organizations
solution_components.role: Applies account-level governance for the internal operations and automation workflows.

solution_components.name: AWS Control Tower
solution_components.role: Standardizes account guardrails and landing-zone controls for the internal operations and automation workflows.

solution_components.name: AWS CloudFormation
solution_components.role: Provision infrastructure as code for the internal operations and automation workflows.

solution_components.name: AWS CloudFormation StackSets
solution_components.role: Pushes shared infrastructure templates across accounts for the internal operations and automation workflows.

data_flow: The process took 10 months and was an iterative process with the company adding more features over time.
business_outcome: Now that Clearwater has gone public, it is looking to scale across geographic regions by focusing on portfolio expansion in Europe. Clearwater is also considering generative artificial intelligence for its products using additional AWS services—all this while keeping security at the forefront of its solutions.
